label: verify-bm-building-physics-standards

claims.claim: England relevant building (storey >=18 m, dwellings/institution/residential room) must use A2-s1,d0 or A1 in external walls and specified attachments; shading slats not exempt; shading up to 4.5 m outside the rule.
claims.source_says: components associated with a solar shading device excluding components whose primary function is to provide shade or deflect sunlight such as the awning curtain or slats. ADB 12.20: Solar shading devices installed up to 4.5m above ground level are not required to meet the requirements of regulation 7(2).
claims.note: Reg 7(2), 7(3)(ha), 7(4) and ADB vol 2 para 12.20 all read as claimed; 'single hardest gate' is a judgment.

claims.claim: SBI needs 495x1500 and (1000+t)x1500 mm wings, at least 3 specimens, so a desk print cannot be classified; Formlabs publishes only UL 94 (HB at 3 mm for rated sheets, 9 of 25 sheets; Flame Retardant V-0 3 mm, V-1 2.5 mm, HB 1.5 mm); UL 94 absent from ADB.
claims.source_says: A complete test requires that at least 3 specimens are tested. Long wing: 495 mm x 1500 mm; Short wing: 1000 + (product thickness) mm x 1500 mm. Flame Retardant TDS: UL 94 V-0 (3mm) V-1 (2.5mm) HB (1.5mm).
claims.note: SBI sizes, Flame Retardant ratings, Rigid 10K HB at 3 mm and zero UL 94 matches in ADB2 all reproduced; the '9 of 25 data sheets' count was not re-checked, and 'only UL 94' is an absence claim.

claims.claim: No standard exists for humidity-responsive facade elements; practice is bespoke chamber protocol (Cheng 2024: 170 cycles 90/30 % RH at 6 h, 96 h ISO 4892 UV at 60 C, 10/20/30 C RH matrix); nearest England wording is Approved Document 7 para 1.27.
claims.source_says: AD7 1.27: Materials that are susceptible to changes in their properties may be used in building work and will meet the requirements of the regulations if the residual properties... Residual properties can be estimated at the time of their incorporation.
claims.note: Cheng parameters (170 cycles, 120 min at 90 % plus 240 min at 30 %, 96 h at 60 C, 10/20/30 C) and AD7 1.27 are confirmed; 'no standard exists' is an absence claim I could not prove.

claims.claim: Formlabs CTEs differ by 114-127 um/m/C between Rigid 10K and Tough 1000, giving 0.45-0.51 % strain over 40 K vs an estimated 0.2 % hygroscopic strain; creep/ageing data only at 22 C or graphs; Tough 1500 V2 DMA modulus inflection at 60.8 C.
claims.source_says: Tough 1500 V2 TDS: A glass transition is observed at 109.6 C, and an inflection of the storage (elastic) modulus is observed at 60.8 C.
claims.note: The 60.8 C figure and the arithmetic reproduce (161.6-48=113.6; 168.2-41=127.2; x40 K gives 0.454-0.509 %), but the 0.2 % hygroscopic estimate is the agent's own and uncheckable here, and the CTE pairing is read from garbled PDF text.

overall: Core legal and datasheet facts reproduce from primary sources. Three of the four claims are partly supported, because each leans on an absence assertion, a count of data sheets, or an internal estimate that I did not re-verify.
